about_short_description.short_description: Yemaachi Biotechnology provides diversifying precision cancer diagnostics and treatments.

product.name: GeneStrat™ EGFR ctDNA
product.description: A blood-based test analyzing circulating tumor DNA and RNA for mutation detection in non-small cell lung cancer patients to support treatment decisions.

product.name: Sheba HPV Test
product.description: A molecular diagnostic test combining self-sampling for detection of 15 high and medium risk HPV strains linked to cervical cancer.

product.name: SMA Genetic Testing Program
product.description: A genetic test for detecting Spinal Muscular Atrophy mutations offered free to eligible patients in Ghana, Nigeria, and Cote d’Ivoire.

product.name: COVID-19 PCR Testing
product.description: Accredited laboratory service offering COVID-19 PCR testing with drive-up and in-residence sample collection and travel certification.

product.name: Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) Services
product.description: Sequencing services including whole genome, whole exome, targeted, whole RNA, and long read sequencing for human and pathogen genetics.

identifier.value: AfriCAN African Clinical Cancer Research Network

product.name: AfriCAN African Clinical Cancer Research Network
product.description: A collaborative network of African clinicians and researchers focused on pan-African cancer research and knowledge sharing.
